text:
Kumar: kicking off post-launch soak for eu-new (GPU pool v2). 3h in — noticing autoscaler oscillation and slow KV cache warmups on burst traffic. attaching brief notes.
Alyssa: can you paste the scale events / timestamps? want to see the backoff pattern.
Kumar: here are recent events (filtered): 
  - 1718467100 scaleUp from 8 -> 16 (util 78%)
  - 1718467160 scaleDown from 16 -> 10 (util 54%)
  - 1718467220 scaleUp 10 -> 18 (util 80%)
  - 1718467300 scaleDown 18 -> 9 (util 50%)
Devin: looks like scaleDown is too aggressive. what are our scaleDownUnneededTime/stabilization windows? default 30s will flap on bursty LLM traffic. bump to 300s at least for new regions.
Maria: oncall logs show a couple of OOM kills on worker-gpu-3 shortly after scaleDown; suspect cold-starts + kernel paging spikes.
ops-bot: ALERT: autoscaler-flap eu-new-gpu-pool — 9 events in 12m. Recommend manual intervention to prevent cascading drain.
Zane: ideas: prewarm a small reserved pool and set minReplicas to avoid full downsizing. also increase HPA stabilizationWindowSeconds and add a longer scaleDownDelay for pods with KV cache.
Alyssa: agree. we should be conservative with minReplicas for first 24h. cost tradeoff: +2-4 GPUs will add ~$1.2k/day for this region at current burn. want sign-off?
Kumar: propose temporary config: minReplicas: 6, scaleDownUnneededTime: 300s, scaleDownStabilization: 300s. prewarm 4 reserved instances for critical routes only. will monitor costs.
Devin: +1. also recommend disabling aggressive binpacking on GPU nodes for now (leave 1 GPU free per node) so we have capacity headroom for model KV warming.
Maria: deploying tweak now to staging cluster. posting HPA snippet I used (applies to our custom autoscaler):
```
autoscalerConfig:
  minReplicas: 6
  maxReplicas: 48
  metrics:
    - type: Utilization
      target: 70
  scaleDownUnneededTimeSeconds: 300
  stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
  reservedPools:
    - name: prewarm-eu-new
      size: 4
```
Zane: also check network MTU on the new region — we saw packet fragmentation on gRPC streams causing tail latency. mtu=1450 mismatch between k8s CNI and host caused ~200ms p95 spikes earlier.
Kumar: good catch. I ran iperf between a few nodes and saw small MTU mismatches. will standardize to 1450 and roll.
Alyssa: plan for rollout: 1) apply conservative autoscaler config 2) create reserved prewarm pool for critical routes 3) roll MTU fix 4) run 6h soak with synthetic generator focused on tail latency 5) re-evaluate cost vs p95.
Kumar: executing plan. will post updates every 30m. thanks all. :thumbsup:
